lyrics:
[Intro: soft church organ, held chords]

[Verse 1: gentle male voice, organ only]
When the job is gone and the lease is up
And you can't make the numbers reach
When you gave it everything you had
And it still fell out of reach

[Verse 2: piano joins, voice a little fuller]
When you're on the floor of a rented room
With your whole life in a bag
When you're too ashamed to dial the phone
And you dial it, and I'm glad

[Chorus: falsetto, acoustic guitar entering]
Leave the mess, come home
The key's where it always was
Leave the mess, come home
You don't have to say because
I'll put the kettle on

[Verse 3: voice steadier, bass in]
You can sleep in your old bed
There's a dent there shaped like you
We don't have to make a plan
There is nothing you have to do

[Chorus: falsetto, band gathering]
Leave the mess, come home
The key's where it always was
Leave the mess, come home
You don't have to say because
I'll put the kettle on

[Build: chiming electric guitar figure, drums crash in]

[Chant: whole band, gang vocals, loud]
Nothing's ruined, nothing's ruined
You are not what fell apart
Nothing's ruined, nothing's ruined
Come back to the start
Nothing's ruined, nothing's ruined
I have got you. I have got you.

[Final Chorus: everything drops to organ and voice]
Leave the mess, come home
The key's where it always was
I'll put the kettle on

[Outro: organ, a car door, a kettle beginning to boil]
